I see! The original `get_name()` function uses `el.itertext()` which iterates over all text content, and for `AtomicString` instances it calls `html.unescape()`. But for regular strings, it keeps them as-is.

The key insight is that the h1 element's text `'Foo > & bar'` contains raw characters (not escaped). When `itertext()` yields this, it returns `'Foo > & bar'`. So `get_name()` would return `'Foo > & bar'`, not `'Foo > & bar'`.

But the test expects `'Foo > & bar'`. This means either:
1. The test was wrong before (unlikely since findings say tests passed)
2. Something else in the pipeline was escaping these characters
